source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "ដំណាំក្រូចថ្លុង" (Pomelo Cultivation Guide), 2017, 90pp
text:
Suitable soil for pomelo (ការជ្រើសរើសដី) is deep and well-drained, similar to other citrus. The source specifies a target soil pH around 6.5. Land prone to standing water should be avoided, since waterlogged roots are highly vulnerable to root and foot rot diseases (see the Phytophthora/foot-rot entry in this knowledge base).

Where irrigation will be used, farmers are advised to plan and install a water delivery system - drip line piping is shown running across planting rows - before or shortly after planting, so young trees receive even, dependable watering as they establish.
